ledgerSearch.outcome: CTD-0006 is decisive in Part VIII: it requires that no physiological measure determine governance standing, and CTD-0005 adds subsistence to the protected list. The shipped bright-line formulation, which names speak, vote, lead, receive subsistence, and hold equal political standing, is stronger than the baseline's and is kept. CTD-0076 requires Scale as the singular and ICONS only as the plural, which changed several restored sentences in the first Scale and dragon chapters. CTD-0030 forbids presenting the Cardinal Scale as existing. CTD-0036 requires the eighty-seven, one hundred and fifty, and five hundred figures to remain distinct with their nesting explained. CTD-0069 governs the use of cultural traditions, which bears on the dragon material. CTD-0081 forbids numerology as evidence and was read. CTD-0012 keeps the Currency of Presence, COHERENCE, and Bio-Consensus distinct.

findings.summary: The imagined civilization lost every particular that made it imaginable.

evidence.baseline: Imagine them sovereign, genuinely sovereign, not branches of anything, not subjects of any center, and yet not isolated ... Imagine trust that travels with a person across the whole network without any central authority owning it. Imagine local cultures flourishing in their full particularity precisely because interoperability has freed them from the choice between isolation and assimilation. Imagine measurement that serves dignity, technology that serves presence, economy that serves the commons, governance that produces wisdom rather than domination.
evidence.shipped: Imagine many Scales, each rooted in its own land and culture, none a branch of a central body. They share protocols and learning without making local life uniform.

findings.authorizedBy: Compression, and catalog 4.9 read onto the repeated Imagine.
findings.diagnosis: The anaphora is a closing invocation and the card permits liturgical closings that end on their image by design. The final Imagine is also a four-clause summary of Parts II, IV, VI, and III in order, which is the volume's last act of structural memory. 4.9's retention limb keeps deliberate recurrence.

findings.summary: The view from above, which is the volume's closing image, was reduced.

evidence.baseline: It would look like what it is: a living body, its sovereign communities arrayed across it like scales, distinct and particular and alive, each itself and all in relationship, an Earth beginning to recognize itself through the communities that have learned to recognize one another. Not conquered. Not centralized. Not flattened into legibility for the sake of control. Alive, and coherent, and awake.
evidence.shipped: That vision is not a world government, nor is it exemption from public law.

findings.authorizedBy: Compression, and catalog 4.15 read onto the closing rise.
findings.diagnosis: The card names Scales catching different light along the dragon among the images that must not be explained away, and permits a small number of earned final lines. This is the earned one. The three denials and the three-word close are the volume's last cadence. The shipped clause about exemption from public law is a real addition and is kept.

findings.summary: Credit, running the other way. The kept public-law and open-wager clauses bound the close without flattening it.

evidence.baseline: From far enough above, such a civilization would not look like a world government, because it would be the opposite of one. ... exists to make this, and only this, possible: a civilization that no longer means the domination of the living world, but participation in its awakening.

Genuine repairs kept on merits, at full credit weight; the restored close and interlude otherwise stand at baseline strength.

reasoning.note: R-LEDGER-WINS. CTD-0076 changed the baseline's closing interlude from The first ICON proves it can be done to The first Scale would prove it can be done, which is the second line the item quotes by name.

R-PUNCT-STRUCT. Five em dashes across the section and the closing interlude. Three were parenthetical appositives and became comma pairs. One introduced a specification of what such a civilization would look like and became a colon. One in the interlude was parenthetical and became a comma pair.

The shipped clauses that the vision is not exemption from public law and that whether the wager survives power, inequality, ecology, and scale remains open. Both bound the closing without flattening it.
The full imagined civilization with its five Imagine clauses, the view from above, the three denials, and the closing interlude with its threshold and its choice.

openQuestions: The restored close ends on the ones not yet born inheriting either wreckage or awakening, and on the choice being ours. That is the volume's most emotionally weighted passage and the corpus card forbids manufactured uplift. It is restored under tonight's policy because the safeguards preceding it are also restored, which is what the card requires an ending to be answerable to. If the author judges it unearned, the repair is to cut rather than to soften.

The volume-04 voice card was prepared by the same pass that produced the shipped text, and its exemplar anchors and protected lines quote that text rather than the baseline. The card records `Author approved: pending tone, strategy, heading, and overcompression review`. The restoration keeps every line the card protects and otherwise follows the baseline, which means card and source now diverge in wording the card does not name. R-VOICE-BIND requires that the disagreement be raised rather than settled here: the card should be re-derived from whichever text the author approves.

Structural labels were frozen for this pass and none was touched. Every markdown heading, every standalone bold display line, every chapter label, and every all-capital display line is byte identical to its pre-edit state, in the same order, with the same blank-line separators on both sides. A label determines a section id, a section id is a public route, and `publishing/continuity/section-lineage.json` already records this volume's renames and resolves the historical routes. Changing one is a continuity decision and not an editorial one. Only the running prose between labels was restored. Where a baseline label names its section better than the current one, the cost is recorded here and the label is left alone.

audits.scope: First standardAudit for this record. Full re-read of the current section against the immutable baseline under all twenty rules, run under the baseline-prepared volume card adopted 2026-07-31 (CTD-0110) and after the 2026-07-31 resolution of CTD-0030. The original record was derived under the thirteen-rule index; this audit adds the substitution count and the later rules: R-LEDGER-WINS-COROLLARY, R-CORRECTION-SCOPE, R-CANON-DELETION-RECORD, R-PAIRED-DELETION, R-CAUTIOUS-HALF, R-SUBSTITUTION-CREDIT, and R-REFRAIN-COST.

substitutionTest.rule: R-CAUTIOUS-HALF, substitution form, run as standing procedure before any pairing test
substitutionTest.method: Normalize both texts, strip markup, split into sentences of three or more words, count baseline sentences appearing verbatim in the current section.
substitutionTest.note: Well above zero, so the pairing test applies. Every non-surviving baseline sentence was attributed: the em dash repairs, the CTD-0076 corrections in the interlude, Scale by Scale and the first-Scale line the item quotes by name, the CTD-0030-conformant modality of the interlude's first-Scale and next-Scale sentences, and the two kept bounding clauses credited as F3.

audits.checked: R-LEDGER-WINS, re-run: CTD-0076 remains open and the interlude corrections it names still stand; CTD-0030 resolved 2026-07-31, and the interlude's would-test modality conforms to its C4. R-CAUTIOUS-HALF: the close keeps its committing halves, alive, and coherent, and awake, the ones not yet born, the choice was always ours; the bounds beside them are additions, not replacements, and are credited rather than treated as losses. R-PAIRED-DELETION: scales, living body, awakening, and the ones not yet born swept two-ended; the dragon section and the volume close carry the other ends and all stand. R-NEGATION-STACK: the not-conquered, not-centralized, not-flattened triple denial precedes its positive claim by design; the rejected alternatives are the three historical failures restored in Earth Awakening to Itself, so 4.3's retention limb and the rule's named-opponent exception both hold and nothing fires. R-CORRECTION-SCOPE: the CTD-0076 corrections verified at width, the quoted lines alone. R-LEDGER-WINS-COROLLARY: nothing seeded. R-REFRAIN-COST: the imagine anaphora runs once as a deliberate liturgical figure, recorded here as its own anchor with count five; the single edit that would change it is removing the figure, which no rule requires and section 6 protects. R-TENSE, R-DEIXIS: nothing fires. Voice card check under the 2026-07-31 card: the ecological-poetry register of Part VIII is the card's named permitted register change; no anchor binds here.
audits.conclusion: Nothing fires. Thirteen of twenty-two baseline sentences survive verbatim; the remainder is attributed. One substitution credit added as F3.
